sens_en: bosom, to cherish, to think of
origine_fr: Le cœur 忄 et 不, qui se lit bù et ne donne pas le son de huái. Dans la forme traditionnelle 懷, une autre partie donnait le son. Garder quelqu'un dans son cœur : penser à lui, le chérir, le serrer contre soi.
origine_en: The heart 忄 and 不, read bù, which does not give the sound of huái. The traditional form 懷 had a part there that gave the sound; it means “to think of, to cherish”. Keeping someone in your heart: thinking of them, holding them close.

mots.en: to miss, to cherish the memory of
